All external dependencies (Oracle JDBC driver, Hadoop HDFS) are available in the test environment via Docker or mock libraries.
Documentation is written in Markdown or AsciiDoc as per project conventions.
Effort estimates assume no major unforeseen blockers or learning curve for these specific user stories.
